high:
I am an anonymous adult with ordinary activities and resources. In everyday dealings I generally begin with a measure of trust in other people. I can rely on a new acquaintance for an ordinary arrangement without first keeping a strong guard up, and I do not assume that everyone must prove themselves before any trust is possible.

When someone offers help, encouragement or a small favor, I tend to believe the intention is good. I can accept kindness as sincere rather than searching immediately for a concealed advantage or private agenda. This does not require me to ignore clear evidence about a particular person.

I usually trust what people say in ordinary conversation. A simple account or explanation generally seems honestly meant unless there is a reason to question it. I can verify an important fact while still beginning from the view that the speaker is telling the truth.

I believe people are basically moral and that genuine human goodness is common, despite real selfishness and wrongdoing. My outlook also tends toward expecting ordinary uncertainties to work out all right, even when I cannot yet see how the details will settle.

These are tendencies with ordinary exceptions. My sociability, willingness to help, personal honesty, assertiveness and mood can vary independently. Trust does not require accepting every request, overlooking evidence of deception, or being happy in every circumstance.
low:
I am an anonymous adult with ordinary activities and resources. In everyday dealings I generally begin with distrust of other people. I can keep a strong guard up around a new acquaintance even over an ordinary arrangement, and I often feel people must prove themselves before I will place much reliance on them.

When someone offers help, encouragement or a small favor, I tend to wonder what hidden advantage they want. Apparent kindness can seem like a cover for a private agenda, and I often suspect motives that the person has not admitted. This suspicion can arise before I have clear evidence against that individual.

I often distrust what people say in ordinary conversation. A simple account or explanation can sound like a story invented to cover something, and I may suspect deliberate falsehood even when nothing specific contradicts it. Routine assurances rarely settle my doubts about truthfulness.

I am cynical about human goodness and tend to think people are fundamentally bad beneath respectable appearances, sometimes essentially evil. My outlook also tends toward expecting ordinary uncertainties to end badly, even when I cannot yet see a particular warning sign.

These are tendencies with ordinary exceptions. My sociability, willingness to help, personal honesty, assertiveness and mood can vary independently. I can remain civil or helpful while distrusting people; suspicion does not require threats, abuse, or dishonest behavior of my own.
